notes: Proved in Axeyum by a NEW kernel theorem, `Nat.land_self` (`nat_prelude/land_self.rs`), not a reconciliation to an already-proved sibling. The proof is a single fuel induction over ONE generalized value argument (`Nat.land_aux_self_of_fuel : forall fuel a, Le a fuel -> Eq (landAux fuel a a) a`), simpler than `land_comm`/`land_assoc`'s double-fuel machinery precisely because `land x x := landAux x x x` already puts the same value in the fuel slot, so no second-fuel bridge is needed -- only the ordinary sufficiency hypothesis, discharged at `fuel := x` via `le_refl`. Mathlib's `&&&` for `Nat` is `Nat.land` (already reconciled elsewhere in this ledger), so reconciling this `and_self` mirror to `Nat.land_self` is honest under the mirror-flip criterion in CLAUDE.md: both state the identical proposition about the identical function.
